articles.title: Vance says Iran must cut nuclear enrichment capacity to reach deal with US
articles.summary:
Vance says Iran must cut nuclear enrichment capacity to reach deal with US

US Vice President JD Vance said that Iran must make a "meaningful" reduction in its nuclear enrichment capacity to satisfy US demands and end the war. 

"If you don't want a nuclear weapon, then why do you need 60% enriched fuel? And if you want to show commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, don't build highly enriched fuel. That's a very basic threshold issue," Vance said during an interview with Reuters.

"I think if they want to show a commitment to not building a nuclear weapon, they would do something meaningful on their enrichment capacity."

Vance also indicated that the US remained open to an agreement but would require concrete Iranian nuclear concessions. "We're not going to trade words for actions," he said.

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává zahájení saúdskoarabské ofenzívy v Jemenu a pokračující útoky v Hormuzském průlivu, což udrží vysokou volatilitu cen komodit a napětí v námořní dopravě.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the launch of the Saudi-led offensive in Yemen and ongoing attacks in the Strait of Hormuz are expected, keeping commodity price volatility and maritime transit tensions high.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the launch of the announced Saudi offensive in Yemen and continued tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz are expected, keeping commodity volatility elevated.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heavy clashes in Yemen and diplomatic talks in Riyadh are expected to continue, keeping regional tensions elevated without an immediate disruption to oil flows.

archive.security_status_cs: V Jemenu probíhá rozsáhlá ofenzíva mezinárodně uznané vlády a saúdskoarabské koalice s cílem získat zpět území ovládaná Houthi, včetně strategického pobřeží a průlivu Bab al-Mandab. archive.security_status_en: A large-scale offensive is underway in Yemen by the internationally recognized government and the Saudi-led coalition to reclaim Houthi-held territory, including the strategic coastline and Bab al-Mandab strait. archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the continuation of the Saudi-led air campaign and ground clashes around Sanaa and Tihamah is expected, keeping market nervousness high.

archive.security_status_cs: Saúdskoarabská koalice zahájila rozsáhlou leteckou a pozemní operaci s cílem vytlačit Hútíje z pobřeží Rudého moře a zajistit strategickou úžinu Bab al-Mandab. Přestože globální dodávky ropy vykazují odolnost díky alternativním trasám, eskalace konfliktů a vojenská mobilizace Turecka a Pákistánu zvyšují geopolitické napětí v regionu.
archive.security_status_en: The Saudi-led coalition has launched a massive air and ground offensive to push the Houthis out of the Red Sea coast and secure the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait. Although global oil supplies show resilience due to alternative routes, escalating conflicts and the military mobilization of Turkey and Pakistan heighten regional geopolitical tensions.
